description: List the merchant's customers. Answers 'who are my customers', 'find John's email', 'has this person bought from us'. Search matches email, first name, last name and full name — NOT phone numbers, addresses or notes. LIMITATION — there is no sorting: results come back in stored order and cannot be ordered by spend, name or last visit. So 'my best customers' or 'who spent the most' CANNOT be answered from this tool, and you must NOT page through everyone trying. Say plainly that sorting is not supported yet, then offer what does work: search by a name or email, or ask the merchant to narrow it down.

search.description: Filter by email, first name, last name or full name
